name: Intercarrotal
storyline:
Intercarrotal draws loose inspiration from the world of Alice in Wonderland—but with a cosmic twist. This game is a fantasy sci-fi spin-off that explores a new interpretation of that universe.
The main hero, a rabbit, suddenly falls through a mysterious tunnel and wakes up on an unknown planet. There, he discovers the secret behind the disappearance of many Wonderland rabbits.
Equipped with magical gear powered by his own inner energy, The rabbit must fight corrupted and mutated rabbits, overcome challenges across multiple stages, and ultimately find the way back home—where Alice awaits him.
summary:
Intercarrotal is an action rogue-like inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, developed using Unreal Engine 5.
The game features a 2.5D visual style, fresh combat mechanics, and a uniquely atmospheric world.
This game was originally created for a local Game Jam called BugsBuzzy, hosted by Sharif University.
Note: The GameJam version was created in just 10 days and it’s unpolished and may contain some bugs.
